subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should the remaining Anthropic signed-thinking prevention work be tracked and fixed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 and its candidate PRs instead of keeping this broad issue as the canonical work item?
rationale: The original recovery failures are implemented on main, while the remaining prevention fix changes provider replay policy and has compatibility-sensitive competing PRs.

options.title: Use #94228 as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers select and land the canonical prevention PR, then close it as covered by the recovery and prevention commits.

options.title: Keep this issue as umbrella
options.body: Continue using this issue as the top-level tracker, but explicitly link #94228, #99382, #99383, and #100149 as scoped subpaths to avoid duplicate fixes.

options.title: Split capture corruption separately
options.body: Close only the recovery portion here and open or designate a separate narrow issue for malformed-at-capture signatures if maintainers want that root cause tracked independently.

recommendation.title: Use #94228 as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers select and land the canonical prevention PR, then close it as covered by the recovery and prevention commits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already summarized the recovery/prevention split in this issue and is the clearest discussion-side routing owner from the available evidence.
